title: Sobha — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
Sobha Ltd. is a public real estate company founded in 1995, headquartered in Bangalore, India. It specializes in real estate development, including residential and commercial properties, interior design and manufacturing, and construction contracting. Notable projects include Sobha Hartland I in Dubai, which was highly successful, leading to the development of Sobha Hartland II. Sobha Modular, a subsidiary, focuses on manufacturing high-end bathroom pods and developing modular projects in the U.S. and Australia. The company has over 32,000 residential units under construction across the UAE.

Sobha Group went public in 2006 in India, and eventually moved over to Dubai in 2010. One of the first projects included the development of Sobha Hartland I, 8 million square feet of mixed-use buildings in Mohammed Bin Rashid City in Dubai. The project was so popular that they sold all properties and are in the process of making a Sobha Hartland II. In addition, they also have over 32,000 residential units under construction across the UAE in various phases. [...] The modular firm, nestled under the umbrella of parent company Sobha Group, is pioneering manufacturing work one bathroom pod at a time.

With its 2.7 million square foot factory in UAE, Sobha Modular is bringing both its high-end bathroom pods to high-end residences in Dubai while developing modular projects for the U.S. and Australia.

Robotic-mockups_1200x800 [...] As owners of the entire value chain, Sobha Modular can both spot and fix specific pain points that can be hard for developers, general contractors, and manufacturers. The company has over seven years of experience developing envelope facades for buildings, on top of both modular and stick-built construction projects. They started developing bathroom pods as  a product a little over two and a half years ago.

Sobha Realty earns trust by carefully managing every step of development. Its Backward Integration model means that the company handles design, engineering, materials, and construction in-house, while “The Art of Detail” philosophy ensures quality at every stage. This approach allows the results speak for the brand, rather than relying on empty promises. [...] This philosophy is brought to life through Sobha Realty’s Backward Integration model. By maintaining in-house control across design, engineering, manufacturing, and construction, the company effectively eliminates the fragmentation that often compromises quality in large-scale developments. This approach ensures a seamless process and consistently high standards, helping build lasting trust with clients.
